title.rendered: Cloud, IoT, sFlow Traffic Monitoring Tutorials #SFUS18

content.rendered:
Last week we have presented two tutorials at the Sharkfest US 2018 edition:

  • sFlow: Theory and practice of a sampling technology [ slides ]
  • Packet monitoring in the days of IoT and Cloud [ slides ]

We believe these tutorials are interesting for all those who are using ntop (and non ntop tools) and are willing to learn more about sFlow and traffic monitoring in cloud and IoT environments.

Enjoy!
